about_short_description.short_description: Aurelian is an AI platform designed to automate routes, triage, and resolve non-emergency police calls.

product.name: Aurelian AI Public Safety Platform
product.description: A voice AI platform for emergency communications centers that handles non-emergency calls by routing callers, monitoring for emergencies, collecting incident details, and supporting calls for service.

product.name: Aurelian CAD/CHE Integration Service
product.description: An open API service that connects Aurelian’s call-handling workflows with an agency’s computer-aided dispatch or call-handling environment.

product.name: Managed Call Routing Configuration
product.description: A managed service for creating and maintaining call-routing paths tailored to an emergency communications center’s departments, services, and operating requirements.

product.name: Whole-business outsourcing model
product.description: An outsourced back-office service covering HR, finance, compliance, technology, marketing and operations for growing SMEs.
